name: SPIRAL
source:
Timmy is a school boy struggling in his classes as his mind plays tricks on him...

Help Timmy get through each of the classes to stop his worrying and stress. 

[From [url=https://ech0games.itch.io/spiral]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
蒂米是个男学生，却因为自己的思绪不断捉弄自己，而在课堂上苦苦挣扎……

帮助蒂米度过每一堂课，摆脱担忧与压力。

[摘自[url=https://ech0games.itch.io/spiral]itch.io[/url]]
